items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcElrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4be3c11536038145829dbcba17ca15bdea04981e/imagen.png) # 🇺🇾 Hay un límite de 35 competidores para el registro. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución. * **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaSideEvents2023#25090-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaSideEvents2023#25091-competidores-nuevos-newcomers). * Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1). * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles. * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. * Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia. Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA. # 🇬🇧 Competitor limit: 35. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaSideEvents2023#25090-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AltavistaSideEvents2023#25091-competidores-nuevos-newcomers). * Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1). * Competitors must bring their own puzzles. * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. * It is important to read all the information available in the competition website. Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.information: **This competition does not feature 3x3.** While first time competitors are welcome, 3x3 will not be held at this competition. If you would like to compete in 3x3, please see [Ohio State RPAC Cube Clash 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OhioStateRPACCubeClash2023) This competition takes place in Meeting Rooms #1-3 on the upper level of the RPAC. These rooms are slightly hard to find so there will be signs guiding competitors to the rooms. There is a limit of 1 guest per competitor at this competition. **All competitiors must be wearing a colored wristband** while attending the competition in order to gain access to the RPAC facility should you choose to leave and return later. You can pick up your wristband at the registration table.

items.name: Waterloo Favourites B 2023

venue.name: [RIM Park](http://www.waterloo.ca/en/gettingactive/rimpark.asp)
venue.details: The competition takes place at Forbes Hall, on the second floor of RIM Park.

items.information: ## Waterloo Favourites 2023 Series This competition is in a series with [Waterloo Favourites A 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WaterlooFavouritesA2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ## Registration Reminders Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**. You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations and registrations with more than four (4) events will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. Once your registration has been accepted, you will no longer be able to change your events by yourself. If you would like to change them, send the organization team an email and we will change your events for you as long as you inform us before February 4, 2023 at 7:00 PM EST. ## Mailing List We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.
